note: Liberia: an employer may not employ a foreign worker without a current work permit from the Ministry of Labour (Decent Work Act 2015, ch. 45.1), granted only where no qualified Liberian is available; from June 2026 an application needs the post advertised for 30 days. No days without it.

sources.title: Civil Service Agency (Liberia), A Report from the Analysis of the Alien Work Permit 2024 (June 2025)
sources.said: Chapter 45.1 stipulates: "An employer shall not employ a foreign ... worker unless they possess a current work permit issued by the ... Ministry [i.e., the Ministry of Labor]."
